cosmos-standard-availability-zone-surcha.title: Availability zones add 25% to standard provisioned throughput
cosmos-standard-availability-zone-surcha.body: This single-write account enables availability zones on standard provisioned throughput, so the RU/s are billed multiplied by 1.25 in each zone-redundant region. Autoscale includes availability zones at no extra charge, and multi-region-write accounts bill the same with or without zones. Compare autoscale if the load varies.

citation.source: Azure Cosmos DB pricing (autoscale provisioned throughput)
citation.quote: Availability zone is included free for autoscale resources
